# G06 — Topology-first UX experiments

**Goal:** Build independently testable interaction trace prototypes for membrane dock, topology bloom, liquid tabs, border pulse, notification metamorph. Keyboard and reduced-motion parity; each demo emits focus, identity and topology ledger rather than decorative-only frame. E01/E02/E03/E08/E09.

**Write-set exclusive:** `docs/agent-results/blobin-next-01/G06.md` and `experiments/blobin-next-01/G06/**`. The latter is an original private lab, **not blob.in production source**. Do not edit other workers, shared shader code, historical blob.in snapshot, Gnosix or the in.gnu6 engine.

**Gate:** define a minimal adversarial input and reproducible outcome. Record exact source+toolchain, dependency lock, viewport/DPR, hardware when relevant, verification results and a clear unsupported/NOT_RUN path. No invented benchmark or GPU proof. CPU compatibility and identity ownership must be addressed even for GPU-specific work.

**Handoff:** original committed lab code if implemented + one evidence report; declare candidate shared interfaces as proposals; integrator reconciles after all workers finish.
